clue.text: Plant a piece of equipment in Welsh town

indicators.note: in says one piece sits inside the Welsh town's name

parts.note: Mold is a town in Flintshire, north Wales
A plus rig; a rig is a piece of apparatus or kit, as in a drilling rig

explanation.surface: Someone sets up a bit of kit in a small town in Wales.
explanation.walkthrough: MOLD is a market town in north-east Wales; 'Plant' reads as a verb but is the noun definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The marigold is a common garden flower with orange or yellow blooms, so an example of a plant.

clue.text: Look gloomy as this person outside work

indicators.note: outside says one piece goes around the other

parts.note: this person is the setter speaking of themself, me
op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: The setter looks glum standing outside the workplace.
explanation.definitionFit: To mope is to sulk listlessly, acting downcast.

clue.text: Governor that helps to lay down a measure

definitions.meaning: a monarch or other person in charge

definitions.text: that helps to lay down a measure
definitions.meaning: a straight-edged measuring strip used to mark lengths

explanation.surface: A head of state who helps pass a law.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lay down a measure' reads as passing legislation but means marking out a length.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a sovereign who governs; the other is the drawing tool marked in centimetres or inches.

clue.text: Become excited as passengers leaving Heathrow must

definitions.meaning: an idiom for losing one's temper or getting worked up
those departing by plane rise skywards

explanation.surface: Travellers flying out of London's main airport get worked up.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to get agitated; literally, flyers taking off rise into the sky.

clue.text: More than one luminary comes down to earth

definitions.meaning: a luminary is a source of illumination, so the plural noun
to land or settle after descending, as a bird does

explanation.surface: Several famous figures are humbled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'luminary' suggests a celebrity, but here it is a lamp or star giving illumination.
explanation.definitionFit: Lamps are plural sources of brightness; a bird that alights settles on the ground.

clue.text: Wild animals, a nuisance for the most part

indicators.note: for the most part says only most of the word is kept, its last letter lost

parts.note: a pest is an annoying person or thing

explanation.surface: Wild creatures are mostly a bother.
explanation.definitionFit: Gorillas, chimps and other primates are wild animals, the plural noun matching the plural answer.

clue.text: Map's dot could show where important conference was held

indicators.note: could show hints the letters may be laid out differently to reveal the place

explanation.surface: A dot on a map marks the site of a historic summit.
explanation.walkthrough: The Potsdam Conference of 1945 settled post-war Germany.
explanation.definitionFit: The German city near Berlin hosted the Allied leaders' summit in summer 1945.

clue.text: Stopping outside front of restaurant or wandering off?

indicators.note: outside says the word for stopping wraps around a letter
front of points to the first letter of restaurant

explanation.surface: Someone lingering outside a restaurant, or drifting away?
explanation.definitionFit: Straying is roaming from the right path, a synonym of drifting away.

clue.text: Science laboratory's termination follows this microbe getting out of control

indicators.note: follows says the lab's final letter comes after the rearranged letters
getting out of control suggests the letters run riot into a new order
termination points to the end letter of laboratory

explanation.surface: A lab's work ends after a microbe runs wild.
explanation.walkthrough: 'follows' puts Y, the last letter of 'laboratory', after the rearranged THIS MICROBE.
explanation.definitionFit: Biochemistry is a branch of science studying chemical processes in living things.

clue.text: Rice Paul cooked around one

indicators.note: around says the reworked name wraps another piece
cooked suggests the name is worked over and rearranged

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Paul has prepared some rice dish round one person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooked' turns PAUL into PLAU; 'around' puts I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Pilau is a spiced rice dish, so the dish is named by its main grain.

clue.text: Sparkly stuff not much good — rubbish

indicators.note: not much of the word good means only its opening letter is used

parts.note: litter is rubbish dropped in public places

explanation.surface: Sparkly decoration is of little worth, mere rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: Glitter is tiny shiny flakes used for decoration, literally sparkly material.

clue.text: A city's dream I recollected sometime in November

indicators.note: recollected read as re-collected says these letters are gathered again in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone recalls a dream about a city, a date in November.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recollected' looks like remembering but signals the letters collected again.
explanation.definitionFit: Remembrance of the 1918 truce falls on 11 November each year, a date within that month.

clue.text: Settlement with alarm finds old clan member

parts.note: a camp is a temporary settlement
a bell can sound an alarm

explanation.surface: A clansman of old discovers a settlement with an alarm.
explanation.walkthrough: The Campbells are a Scottish Highland clan.
explanation.definitionFit: Campbell is the name of a historic Scottish clan, so a Campbell is one of its members.

clue.text: Acknowledges it's mad getting drunk

indicators.note: getting drunk suggests these letters reel about into a fresh order

explanation.surface: Someone confesses that drinking is madness.
explanation.definitionFit: To admit something is to own up to or concede it, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Like a husband or wife being spoilt, one gathered

indicators.note: gathered says the spoilt word takes one into its midst

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A spouse is spoilt and gathers someone in.
explanation.definitionFit: Spouses are wedded, the adjective describing anyone who has a husband or wife.

clue.text: Fresh fellow who became a cardinal?

explanation.surface: A new man rises to the rank of cardinal.
explanation.walkthrough: John Henry Newman, the Victorian Anglican convert, was made a Catholic cardinal in 1879.
explanation.definitionFit: The definition is a description of a famous person, the churchman made a prince of the Church.

clue.text: Conditions for different parts of America?

definitions.meaning: the fifty divisions of the USA

explanation.surface: Circumstances vary across regions of America.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means circumstances or situations, and also the federal divisions such as Texas or Ohio.

clue.text: Something good for cricketers? It helps one strike the right note

definitions.meaning: a cricket pitch is the strip the ball is bowled on; an ideal one suits players

definitions.text: It helps one strike the right note
definitions.meaning: the musical gift of naming or singing any note without a reference tone

explanation.surface: Something that pleases cricketers and also helps a singer stay in tune.
explanation.walkthrough: A cricket pitch is the 22-yard strip of the field where bowling and batting happen.
explanation.definitionFit: Absolute tonal hearing lets a musician hit a note exactly; a flawless playing surface delights a cricket team.

clue.text: Island that's cold most of spring month

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold on a tap

indicators.note: most of says the month loses its last letter

parts.note: April is a month of spring

explanation.surface: An island chilly for most of a spring month.
explanation.definitionFit: Capri is an island in the Bay of Naples, Italy.

clue.text: Hard work finishing early? Smile

indicators.note: finishing early says the word stops before its last letter

parts.note: a grind is hard, tedious work

explanation.surface: Knocking off early from tough work brings a smile.
explanation.definitionFit: A grin is a broad smile, a direct synonym.

clue.text: English Literature is initially timely for choosy person

indicators.note: initially says take the opening letter of the next word

explanation.surface: English Literature is the timely choice for a discerning reader.
explanation.definitionFit: A snob who favours only the select few is a fastidious, choosy type.

clue.text: What fat a person carries to get thinner gradually

indicators.note: carries says the words fat a person hold the answer within them

explanation.surface: Asking what a fat person carries, before they slim down gradually.
explanation.walkthrough: 'What' and 'to' are link words; the answer spans the words 'fat a person'.
explanation.definitionFit: To taper is to narrow steadily towards one end, so grow slimmer bit by bit.

clue.text: Female bringing joy ultimately to boy

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of joy

explanation.surface: A girl makes a boy happy in the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A lady is a woman, a polite noun for a female.

clue.text: One of the old people says Iran must reform

indicators.note: must reform tells us the letters have to be formed again in another order

explanation.surface: A political claim that Iran has to change its ways.
explanation.definitionFit: The Assyrians were an ancient Mesopotamian nation, so a member is one of an old people.
